title: Tensor normalization of the pullback/stalk evaluation comparison
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field, $s=\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$, $Z$ any scheme and $h:Z\to s$. Work in the unbounded integer-coefficient derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with ordinary derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Let $K=C_s$ and $S=S_D$ be the normalized constant/stalk equivalence of [lem-kun-geometric-point-derived-constants], with counit $v:KS\to1$. Let $F=h^{-1}$ be exact derived inverse image and $c^F_{A,B}:F(A\otimes B)\to FA\otimes FB$ its canonical comonoidal comparison [lem-kun-inverse-image-monoidal]. Let $L=C_Z$ be derived constants with the normalized comparison $c^L_{M,N}:L(M\otimes N)\to LM\otimes LN$ of [def-kun-constant-projection-morphism]. The canonical pullback-of-constants identification [lem-kun-pullback-constant], transported by the exact-functor identifications as in [lem-kun-geometric-point-derived-sections-adjunction], is $\gamma:KF\xrightarrow{\sim}L$. Define $\sigma_A=F(v_A)\circ\gamma_{SA}^{-1}:L(SA)\to FA$. For every $A,B\in D(s_{\mathrm{Et}},\mathbf Z)$, one has
$$c^F_{A,B}\circ\sigma_{A\otimes B}=(\sigma_A\otimes\sigma_B)\circ c^L_{SA,SB}\circ L(c^S_{A,B}).$$
Here $c^S_{A,B}:S(A\otimes B)\to SA\otimes SB$ is the fixed monoidal stalk constraint. This is solely a compatibility of inverse image and evaluation with tensor, with no hypothesis on boundedness or $h$.

proof.text: On ordinary sheaves, the pullback-of-constants comparison [lem-kun-pullback-constant] sends a constant section to that same constant section. The counit of the normalized equivalence [lem-kun-geometric-point-derived-constants] sends a germ to its unique representing global section. To check the tensor equation, take germs represented by sections $a,b$. Both composites send $a\otimes b$ to the tensor of their pullbacks. Pure tensors generate the module tensor product. The sheafification universal property extends the equation from constant-presheaf sections to the sheaf tensor product. Thus the ordinary comparison $L S\to F$ is comonoidal for the normalized constant and stalk structures.

proof.text: Choose flat K-flat representatives for the two input objects using [lem-kun-flat-resolution-existence]. The point equivalence carries these to K-flat representatives on the coefficient side; inverse image and constants preserve the flat/K-flat representatives used for their canonical comparisons [lem-kun-inverse-image-monoidal], [def-kun-constant-projection-morphism]. In each bidegree the maps from step 1 commute with the tensor comparison. Additivity extends the equality to the direct-sum total complexes, with differential $d\otimes1+(-1)^p1\otimes d$ on each $(p,q)$ summand. All maps have degree zero, so both routes have the same signs.

proof.text: Descend the equality using [lem-kun-derived-tensor-well-defined]. The factorization monoidality of [lem-kun-geometric-point-derived-constants] identifies the descended stalk constraint with the fixed $c^S$. The two other descended constraints are exactly the canonical leftDerivedTensorComparison maps of [lem-kun-inverse-image-monoidal] and [def-kun-constant-projection-morphism]. The canonical exact-functor identifications commute with the localization counits, and the comparison $\gamma$ is their transport of the ordinary pullback-of-constants map [lem-kun-geometric-point-derived-sections-adjunction]. Thus the descended evaluation is precisely the stated $\sigma$. Naturality transports the equation from the chosen representatives to all unbounded objects.

lean.statement:
theorem geometricPoint_pullbackStalk_tensor
    (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (h : Z ⟶ Spec (.of Ω)) :
    letI := (Classical.choice
      (nonempty_geometricPointDerivedConstantsData Ω)).derivedStalkMonoidal
    PullbackStalkTensorCompatible
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)) h).leftDerivedFunctor
      (geometricPointStalk Ω).mapDerivedCategory
      (constantSheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ))).leftDerivedFunctor
      (leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ)) h)
      (constantSheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} ℤ))).leftDerivedTensorComparison
      (geometricPointPullbackStalkComparison Ω h)
lean.note: PullbackStalkTensorCompatible is a transparent formula, not a compatibility hypothesis added to the item. pullbackStalkComparison and its geometric specialization are concrete composites of the canonical inverse constants comparison with the point counit. The theorem is tensor-only and has no direct image or projection morphism. Edge cases checked: h=id, zero objects, the empty scheme Z, and arbitrary unbounded representatives; all use the same degree-zero pure-tensor identity, without nonemptiness, finiteness or boundedness.
